design_notes: Serif throughout, hairline rules in two weights; single accent colour for the industry stat strip and pull-quote rule.
Financials table: right-align all numeric columns, parentheses for negatives, no zebra striping.
Industry snapshot sits between the market-size paragraph and the sub-segment table; keep it scannable, not decorative.

industry_snapshot.after_paragraph: CRISIL Research estimated the Indian chemicals industry, excluding pharmaceuticals and fertilisers, at ₹5,800–6,200 billion in fiscal 2017
industry_snapshot.growth_bars_label: Specialty chemicals — growth, actual vs forecast
industry_snapshot.growth_bars_source: CRISIL Research, as disclosed in the filing [^drhp-p94]
industry_snapshot.rationale: Three headline numbers plus the fragmentation split tell the reader what kind of field this company competes in before the prose explains it.
industry_snapshot.split_bar_label: Market structure — SME share of the field
industry_snapshot.split_bar_note: The filing describes the industry as highly fragmented, with SMEs holding 70–75% market share and only a few Indian players able to compete with global majors on product development [^drhp-p94] [^drhp-p95].

pull_quotes.after_paragraph: Customer concentration is the sharpest number in this section.
pull_quotes.quote: The top 10 customers accounted for around 59%, 57% and 59% of revenue from operations in FY2017, FY2016 and FY2015 respectively [^drhp-p128].
pull_quotes.rationale: Three-fifths of revenue with ten buyers who have no contractual obligation to return is the single most consequential disclosed fact.

sidebars.body_markdown: The issue lists on NSE EMERGE, the SME platform of the National Stock Exchange, with Vivro Financial Services Private Limited as lead manager and Link Intime India Private Limited as registrar [^drhp-p54] [^drhp-p55]. The objects are capital expenditure for a new manufacturing facility at Plot 336, GIDC Waghodia, Vadodara, Gujarat; general corporate purposes; and creating a public trading market for the equity shares [^drhp-p75]. The extracts do not carry the total issue size, the price band, the fresh-issue versus offer-for-sale split, any selling shareholder, the bid dates or the lot size.
sidebars.rationale: Consolidates the offer mechanics and, crucially, states what the filing does not disclose so the reader does not infer it.
sidebars.title: The offer at a glance

tables.after_paragraph: The profit record has a shape: two loss years, then a turn.
tables.footnote: PAT [^drhp-p49]; EPS [^drhp-p177]; total assets [^drhp-p175]; operating cash flow [^drhp-p50]. Filing reports in ₹ lakh; converted at ₹1 crore = ₹100 lakh.
tables.rationale: Six periods of restated numbers are the spine of the report and read faster as a grid than as prose.
